readiness.hed: Fredericksburg holds cold and sunny into this evening near 54 with the coldest night of the week ahead near 27, stays dry and milder Wednesday near 54, then turns wet and windy Wednesday night into a rainy, breezy Thanksgiving Day with a high near 61 and gusts to 40 mph
readiness.insight: The National Weather Service shows no active watches or warnings for Fredericksburg this afternoon. Today stays sunny and cool with a high near 54 under a light north wind, dropping to the week's coldest night tonight, around 27 with winds staying light. Wednesday holds dry and comparable near 54 under mostly cloudy skies with gusts to 23 mph, but rain moves in Wednesday night with a 90 percent chance of precipitation and gusts to 35 mph. That system continues straight into Thanksgiving Day: NWS now puts the high near 61 with a 100 percent chance of rain and gusts to 40 mph, trailing into a mostly cloudy, still-wet Thursday night near 45 with an 80 percent chance of lingering rain before 1 a.m.
actions: Tonight's low near 27 is the coldest night of the week — cover outdoor spigots, bring in sensitive plants, and check on elderly neighbors before bed.
Wednesday daytime is the window to finish outdoor Thanksgiving prep — grocery runs, yard work, travel — before rain moves in Wednesday evening.
Thanksgiving Day itself carries a 100 percent chance of rain with gusts to 40 mph — plan parking, decorations, and any outdoor cooking (turkey fryers) with a firm wet-weather backup.
If you're traveling Wednesday night or early Thursday for the holiday, build in extra time; rain and gusty wind arrive right at the start of the heaviest travel window.
